story.titleZh: 意大利大奖赛周五练习赛赢家与输家盘点
story.summaryZh: 意大利大奖赛对梅赛德斯与法拉利两大车队及其车手而言是重要的周末，媒体从中挑选出周五练习赛的赢家与输家。
story.originalTitle: Winners and losers from Italian GP F1 practice
story.summaryEn: The Italian Grand Prix is a big weekend for Mercedes and Ferrari, and The Race has picked out the winners and losers from Friday practice.
detailZh: 意大利大奖赛对于F1两支最大车队及其车手来说是一个重要的周末。
在梅赛德斯，安东内利是70多年来首位在主场大奖赛上领跑积分榜的意大利车手；而在车房的另一边，拉塞尔知道，考虑到安东内利将带着发车区（发车区）处罚参赛，这个周末为他提供了重燃争夺总冠军希望的绝佳机会。
我们怎么强调蒙扎这场比赛对法拉利的重要性都不为过——尤其是今年，车队仍怀有夺取F1总冠军的外围希望。
那么，这几方中谁开局强劲，谁又与他们并驾齐驱？又有谁已经需要这个周末出现戏剧性的好转呢？
以下是我们评选出的周五赢家与输家及其第二次自由练习赛的名次：
赢家：法拉利的新引擎（第2名和第5名）
法拉利的第二次ADUO升级是本周末前最大的话题，而早期的迹象令人鼓舞——勒克莱尔在第二次自由练习赛中排名第二，只比拉塞尔慢0.120秒，而且在长距离节奏上也名列前茅。
对此我们不仅必须加上通常的提醒，即这只是周五练习赛，还要注意勒克莱尔令人印象深刻的速度是使用软胎做出的，而梅赛德斯车手以及利亚姆·劳森那辆速度飞快的红牛赛车使用的是硬胎。
周五并不是下确定性结论的日子，但在一条会暴露法拉利动力劣势的赛道上，这至少是一个充满希望的开端。
考虑到两位车手都在使用的引擎升级本来就没指望能彻底消除劣势、而是缩小差距，这对于蒂福西（Tifosi，法拉利车迷）来说是令人鼓舞的。——埃德·斯特劳
输家：本田的最新引擎（第19名和第22名）
费尔南多·阿隆索周四表示，与这款升级引擎首秀的赞德福特赛道相比，蒙扎或许是检验本田的F1引擎究竟改进了多少的更好试金石。
而且，嗯……从这方面来看，初步结果并不理想。
蒙扎是一条马力至上的赛道。本田在这里很可能会暴露短板；赛道现场总经理兼总工程师折原晋太郎承认需要保持"现实"，并表示这对动力单元方面来说将是"具有挑战性的"。
但本田、阿斯顿·马丁和阿隆索（以及队友兰斯·斯特罗尔）肯定希望有比垫底更好的表现——他们的成绩夹在两台凯迪拉克之间，而且实际上比倒数第二慢的车每圈要慢超过一秒。（不计算埃斯特班·奥孔的哈斯赛车。）——杰克·科曾斯
"我不知道我们能否说自己是这个周末的热门，但比起过去两场比赛，我们可能拥有更大的机会——过去两场比赛的关键不太在于动力单元，而更多在于底盘。"
“现在差距非常小，排位赛里最后那零点一秒就可能决定几个名次，而这可能会改变领奖台的格局。现在，我还不知道哪支车队会是最强的那一支。”
这是拉塞尔在周四说的话，而在周五练习赛中登顶之后，他成了蒙扎赛道上“最需要被击败的车手”，他在第一节自由练习中还落后法拉利零点三秒，但在第二节自由练习中反超了勒克莱尔零点一二零秒。
这样一条缺乏能量的赛道理应天然发挥梅赛德斯赛车套件的固有优势，而且到了周六的第三节排位赛，拉塞尔还可以指望受到处罚的队友、同时也是冠军竞争对手安东内利的帮助。
因此，尽管我们还不知道升级后的ADUO 2法拉利引擎能带来多少额外性能，同时拉塞尔也必须面对自己那台梅赛德斯引擎已经相当疲劳的事实，但他至少已经以非常强势的姿态开启了这场比赛的周末。——本·安德森
还记得马克斯·维斯塔潘与红牛续约的消息公布时，车队和车手双方共同流露出的那份乐观情绪吗？
也许在这里直接把那件事拿来对比有失公允；维斯塔潘和红牛都知道他们本赛季不是冠军争夺者，即便那些亮眼的成绩也需要这位四届世界冠军使出一点魔力。
不过，自赞德沃特赛前那次公告以来，性能层面的局面看起来相当糟糕：在荷兰的冲刺赛中获得第六；在荷兰大奖赛中撞车；随后在蒙扎的第二次自由练习中又出现了种种抱怨——下压力完全不足（因此改了尾翼）、低速弯缺乏抓地力、刹车不给力，以及前轴出现“弹跳”。
这些问题现在看起来非常严重，以至于可能再次需要维斯塔潘上演英雄般的操作——只不过这次只是为了把红牛抬到中游集团之上。——JC
哈斯车队2026年最大的一次升级已经到位——但只完全装在了贝尔曼的车上。
他在第二节练习赛中带着新的车身套件和法拉利引擎（队友奥孔没有这两样装备）拿到了第八名，只比拉塞尔创造的最快圈速慢0.8秒，落后小红牛车队的阿尔维德·林德布拉德0.02秒。
“这绝对是我们大概自三月或那一时期以来最好的一个星期五，”贝尔曼说。
“我们需要一些提振，而今天对整个车队来说是一个巨大的提振，”他补充道。
贝尔曼对他对新升级套件的称赞加以保留——新套件让他在弯道中获得更多下压力，整体上也更有信心——原因在于周六的比赛将取决于尾流和赛道位置。
他补充说，这辆车的空气阻力比对手的稍大一些——但这是一个巨大的进步。
哈斯车队车辆工程主管霍吉·尼德表示：“这是一次巨大的升级。我们更新了所有的底盘。几乎座舱以后的所有车身部件都换新了。”
尼德呼应了贝尔曼的说法，即周五在蒙扎的表现是车队今年最强之一，哈斯希望能在周日的比赛中终结连续六站颗粒无收的局面。——萨马思·卡纳尔
奥孔虽然用上了新的车身套件，但并没有用上新的法拉利引擎，这是由于一级方程式技术规则中关于额外引擎认证步骤的一个特殊规定所致。他在第二节自由练习赛结束时比哈斯车队队友贝尔曼慢了一秒多。
哈斯车队的尼德确实试图淡化这种差距，他表示，奥孔或许没有得到"跻身前列的最佳机会"，因为新引擎并不能完全解释这种差距。
在第二节自由练习赛的飞驰圈中，交通拥堵也让奥孔吃了亏——这是蒙扎的经典桥段。
但很难回避这样一个事实：法拉利引擎（相对）缺乏爆发力，在这座速度圣殿将会非常痛苦，到了排位赛和正赛日，奥孔可能会发现自己位于车阵的尾部。——天空体育
detailEn: The Italian Grand Prix is a big weekend for two of Formula 1's biggest teams and their drivers.

At Mercedes, Kimi Antonelli is the first Italian driver to be leading the championship at their home grand prix for more than 70 years; while on the other side of the garage, George Russell knows this weekend offers a big chance to reignite his title challenge considering Antonelli is carrying a grid penalty.
And we can't really overstate how significant the Monza race is to Ferrari - not least this year, where it still has outside hopes of winning the F1 title.
So who from that quarter has started off strong, and who else is up with them? And who already needs the weekend to take a drastic upturn?
Here's our pick of Friday winners and losers and their FP2 positions:
Winner: Ferrari's new engine (2nd & 5th)

Ferrari's second ADUO upgrade has been the big talking point heading into the weekend, and the early signs are promising - with Charles Leclerc second fastest in FP2, 0.120s off Russell's pace and right up there on long-run pace.

To this we must add not only the usual caveat that this is Friday practice, but also the fact Leclerc's impressive pace was on the soft Pirellis versus the hards used by the Mercedes drivers - and the rapid Red Bull of Liam Lawson.
Friday isn't the day for definitive conclusions, but it's at least a promising start for Ferrari at a circuit that exposes its power deficit.
And given that the engine upgrade, which both drivers are running, was never expected to wipe out the disadvantage but reduce it, that's encouraging for the Tifosi. - Edd Straw
Loser: Honda's latest engine (19th & 22nd)
Fernando Alonso suggested on Thursday that Monza might be the better test of how much Honda's improved its F1 engine than the Zandvoort circuit at which it made its debut.
And, well... the initial results don't look great on that score.

Monza is the circuit where power is king. Honda was always likely to be exposed here; trackside general manager and chief engineer Shintaro Orihara accepted the need to be "realistic" and said it would be "challenging for [the] power unit side".

But Honda, Aston Martin, and Alonso (and team-mate Lance Stroll) would've wanted better than to be back at the foot of the table, sandwiching the Cadillacs, and realistically more than a second a lap off the next-slowest car. (Discounting Esteban Ocon's Haas.) - Jack Cozens

"I don't know if we can say we're favourites this weekend, but we probably have a greater opportunity than we've had in the last two races where it's been less about the power unit and more about the chassis.
"It's so close right now, that last tenth in qualifying can be the difference of a couple of positions, which can change the podium. Right now, I don't know who is going to be the team to beat."
This was Russell speaking on Thursday, before he became the 'driver to beat' at Monza by topping Friday practice, overturning a three-tenth deficit to Ferrari in FP1 to lead Leclerc by 0.120s in FP2.

Such an energy-starved circuit should naturally play to the inherent strengths of the Mercedes package, and Russell can also count on assistance from penalised team-mate and title rival Kimi Antonelli come Q3 on Saturday.

So, although we can't yet know how much extra performance is to come from that upgraded ADUO 2 Ferrari engine, while Russell also has to deal with the fact his own Mercedes engine is growing quite tired, he's at least started this weekend very much on the front foot. - Ben Anderson
Remember when Max Verstappen's new Red Bull deal was announced and all the mutual optimism that was shared by team and driver?

Perhaps it's unfair to use that as a direct callback here; Verstappen and Red Bull know they're not title contenders this season and even the results that have stood out have required a touch of magic from the four-time world champion.

Still, the performance picture looks rough since that pre-Zandvoort announcement: sixth in the sprint in the Netherlands; a crash in the Dutch GP; and then the various complaints - of a total lack of downforce (and resulting wing change), lack of grip in slow-speed corners, the brakes not working, and the car "jumping" on the front axle - in FP2 at Monza.
Those seem so bad right now that some Verstappen heroics might be needed once again - only this time just to hoist Red Bull above the midfield. - JC
Haas's biggest upgrade of 2026 has landed - but only completely on Bearman's car.

And he took the new bodywork and Ferrari engine (which team-mate Ocon doesn't have) to eighth in second practice, just 0.8s off the ultimate pace set by Russell and 0.02s behind Racing Bulls's Arvid Lindblad.
"It's definitely been our best Friday since probably March or that time of year," said Bearman.
"We're in need of a bit of a boost and today has been a big boost for the entire team," he added.

Bearman caveated his praise of the new upgrade package - giving him more downforce through corners and more confidence throughout - with the fact that Saturday will be about slipstreams and track position.
He added that the car is a bit more draggy than rivals' - but it's a huge step up.
Haas head of car engineering Hoagy Nidd said: "It's a huge upgrade. We've updated all of the chassis. It's all of the bodywork rearwards of the cockpit pretty much."
Nidd echoed Bearman's comments on Friday at Monza being among the team's strongest of the year, as Haas looks to halt a six-strong run of point-less weekends on Sunday. - Samarth Kanal

Ocon has the new bodywork but not the new Ferrari engine, as part of a quirk of F1's technical regulations around additional engine homologation steps, and ended the day more than a second off Haas team-mate Bearman in FP2.
Haas's Nidd did play down the difference, saying that Ocon perhaps wasn't given "the best opportunity to get up there" as the new engine doesn't completely account for the disparity.
Traffic also cost Ocon on his FP2 push laps - a classic trope at Monza.

But it's hard to get past the fact that a (relative) lack of Ferrari engine pep will be painful at the temple of speed and Ocon might find himself towards the back of the pack come qualifying and race day. - SK

detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔夺得杆位，梅赛德斯车队在卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛中占据领先，这是自5月份加拿大大奖赛以来的首次。
以下是排位赛三部分的全部结果：
11 Ollie 贝尔曼 (哈斯) 1m23.367s +0.240s (与Q3差距)

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
